name: Coenzyme Q10

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A lipid-soluble benzoquinone carrying electrons in the mitochondrial respiratory chain. Its synthesis shares the mevalonate pathway that statins inhibit, which is the rationale for co-supplementation.

systems.note: Taken for myocardial and skeletal-muscle bioenergetics; the intended effect.
Also taken to offset the mevalonate-pathway depletion statins cause.
Structurally related to vitamin K and reported to antagonise warfarin.

monitors.why: The muscle marker for the statin-myopathy rationale it is taken under.
